title: faber UI catalogue
intro: Every kit part in `ui/src/kit/`, with when to use it, its states and its props (ADR-0042).
Read by whoever composes a screen. The rules are in [guidelines.md](guidelines.md); sizes come from the control ladder (ADR-0039).
Every entry has a story per state in `ui/src/kit/*.stories.tsx`, browsed with `npm run storybook` (ADR-0043). `catalog:check` fails on an entry without one.

groups.name: Kit
groups.intro: Base UI parts wrapped once, sized from the control ladder. Screens import these from `ui/src/kit`, never Base UI.

groups.name: Blocks
groups.intro: The popover's and the dashboard's pieces, composed from the kit: each is one row, mark or section of a screen, with a story per state.

groups.name: Screens
groups.intro: Each surface's screens, composed from the kit.
